Generate a complete Python 3.11 script (return code only) for new file `分析产出/backtest_shared_standards.py`; do not attempt filesystem access. It will live beside `screen_sh.py` and `screen_sz.py`. Interfaces: import screen_sh and screen_sz; call each module's `main()` with temporary sys.argv `--base DATE --no-gov --non-bank --output-dir DIR`. SH output is `沪市主池_筛选结果.csv`, candidate symbol column `代码后缀`; additionally keep only rows where `过⑫⑬⑭` is true (Shanghai-specific stage-two liquidity/yield gates). SZ output is `深市专用标准_筛选结果.csv`, symbol column `symbol`. Use temporary CWD per invocation to prevent holdings-file reads/writes; redirect stdout to StringIO and restore cwd/sys.argv/stdout in finally. No governance or bank metrics in the backtest.
Use DuckDB read-only path `D:/repository/数据湖/data/cnequity/duckdb/cnequity.duckdb`. Cohorts: 2025-05-30, 2025-06-30, 2025-07-31, 2025-08-29, 2025-09-30, 2025-10-31, 2025-11-13; end is calendar anniversary and use latest global `daily_bars_adj.trade_date` on/before anniversary. For each cohort run both screeners. Build same-date basic-universe benchmark from `instruments`: SH/SZ main board only (exclude SH 688/900 and SZ 200/30), stock, list_date <= base minus 3 years, delist_date null or >base; latest `trading_status` per symbol where trade_date<=base (tie order date/fetched_at/data_version/source/status/risk_warning); exclude risk_warning and status='delisted'; latest `industry_members` Eastmoney per symbol where as_of_date<=base (tie order date/fetched_at/data_version/source/name); exclude banks by historical industry. Do not use current company name for historical bank/ST filtering.
Returns: read `daily_bars_adj` only; for each symbol latest row <= base and <= endpoint; require `adj_is_exact is true` and qfq_close finite >0 at both points. Use price ratio end/start - 1 only; never add corporate_actions separately. If no row on the endpoint because suspended/delisted, latest prior row is accepted and marked stale; if latest row is inexact/nonpositive/missing, exclude and count. If delisted after base, use last available exact qfq close as cash proceeds; no interest.
